title: Efficacy and Safety of Risedronate Therapy Administered 35 mg Once A Week in Men With Osteoporosis
brief_summary: Two year study to determine the safety and efficacy of weekly 35 mg Risedronate doses in men with osteoporosis followed by a two year follow-up study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Documented osteoporosis of the femoral neck and lumbar spine

Exclusion Criteria:

* BMI greater than or equal to 35
